At r=1/3 the series parameters a=(9+3i)/10 and z=-(1/3+i)t give rational Gaussian-rational 80-term approximants. Independent non-opaque exact-fraction reconstruction (separate script) verified four squared-value inequalities using geometric factorial tail bounds, yielding D(7.5)<.038,D(10)>.111,D(14)<.035,D(16)>.045; errors at four times were bounded by approximately 2.3e-48,2.3e-38,1.1e-26,4.9e-22. Thus disjoint positive variations add to >.083, and distance growth rules out positive trace-preserving propagators. Fixed-time inequalities do not locate all local extrema or determine full BLP supremum.
